title: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion
original_title: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion
overview: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion is an inspiring sports drama that chronicles the extraordinary life of Arjun Chakravarthy, a determined kabaddi player who represented India in the 1980s.
